campaign_usage.call_semantics: Each durable attempt reservation consumes one call slot, including pending or unknown outcomes.
campaign_usage.cost_semantics: observed_cost is calculated from reported usage; reconciled_cost is a billing charge
campaign_usage.timeline_basis: attempt dispatch order; cumulative latest accounting, not historical balances
campaign_usage.usage_semantics: cache reads and writes are disjoint subsets of input; reasoning is included in output

definitions.coordination: Coordinator-purpose usage is a subset of total usage. Peer content in searcher inputs has no exact causal cost attribution.
definitions.cost: Provider usage multiplied by frozen rates; not a billing statement. Unknown amounts remain incomplete; known subtotals include failed attempts.
definitions.curves: Recorded verification events versus cumulative latest ledger accounting in dispatch order; endpoints include all known failure costs. Incomplete endpoints show known subtotals only.
definitions.denominators: Solved means the recorded worker lower bound meets the verified upper bound; a later failed attempt does not erase an earlier solution. Run status still records failures and truncation. Solved/attempted is descriptive; failed attempts remain in costs. Cost per solution is undefined at zero successes and incomplete with unknown cost.
definitions.quality: Best independently valid worker cardinality L; missing recorded values remain null. Distributions use available values only.
definitions.scope: Descriptive case study; all planned rows retained, including unstarted runs and failures.
definitions.tokens: Input plus output only, for attempts with complete token reporting. An incomplete attempt retains a reservation and is not represented as a zero-use call. Cache read/write are disjoint input subsets; reasoning is already in output.
